name: TRACE (Trajectory-based Validated-by-Reproducing Agent-benchmark Complexity Evolution)
description: TRACE is a self-evolving agentic benchmarking framework that uses a multi-agent system to continuously escalate benchmark difficulty. A Proposer agent generates new task ideas, an Executor agent instantiates them into concrete problems, and a Validator confirms solvability via reproducible solution trajectories. Applied to the GAIA benchmark, four rounds of TRACE evolution caused a 22.33% accuracy drop in a leading model, demonstrating its ability to combat benchmark saturation.
typical_sota_score: Drops ~22% relative after 4 evolution rounds on GAIA
reputation: Novel framework addressing benchmark saturation; demonstrated significant accuracy drops on GAIA after self-evolution rounds.
notes: Computational cost of self-evolution rounds is substantial. The 'Validate-by-Reproduce' paradigm provides stronger difficulty guarantees than simple pass/fail. Targets benchmark saturation as a first-class concern.
